executive_summary: Triage and prioritization analysis for lab web server discovered a critical Apache HTTP Server vulnerability (CVE-2021-41773) involving path traversal and remote code execution, which is actively tracked in CISA's KEV catalog.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal and Remote Code Execution
findings.evidence: Host lab-host-12 running Apache httpd 2.4.49 on port 80/tcp
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent
IF cvss is critical AND exposure is internet THEN priority is urgent
IF criticality is high AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Immediately upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later (or the latest stable release) to fully patch path normalization and path traversal flaws. Ensure that directory configurations (such as Require all denied and appropriate Alias / Directory blocks) are strictly enforced. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory).
